title: fix(post): name the wire post Native wire EDM job files
body:
## What changed

- The wire post "Agie native wire EDM" has the new name "Native wire EDM job files". The name is one constant, `posting::agie::POST`.
- The old name is a hidden alias. A saved project, an option key, a script, an MCP call or a machine file that uses the old name still selects the post. No list shows the old name.
- Refusals and UI texts say what is wrong with the job. They do not name the machine brand.
- The 11 `agie-native` `.refusal` goldens change with the `.cps` throw text. No posted program changes.

## User-visible names that changed

| Old text | New text | File |
|---|---|---|
| `Agie native wire EDM` (post name) | `Native wire EDM job files` | `crates/app/src/posting_agie.rs` (`POST`), `assets/posts/agie-native.cps:3`, `examples/agie/punch.camscript`, `docs/user-guide/agie-wire-edm.md`, `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:148` |
| `.cps` option group `Agie technology` | `Wire EDM technology` | `assets/posts/agie-native.cps:10`, `docs/user-guide/agie-wire-edm.md` |
| `.cps` throw `Agie native wire EDM requires the desktop or CLI One program post to a new job directory` | `Native wire EDM job files require the desktop or CLI One program post to a new job directory` | `assets/posts/agie-native.cps:16` |
| Status line `Agie job prepared in {} ({} controller files, zero working steps)` | `Native wire EDM job prepared in {} (...)` | `crates/ui/src/state.rs` |
| Error `Enter an Agie job name of up to eight uppercase letters or digits, starting with a letter` | `Enter a job name of up to eight uppercase letters or digits, starting with a letter` | `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs` |
| Error `Choose One program to create an Agie job directory` | `Choose One program to create a native wire EDM job directory` | `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs` |
| Folder picker title `Choose a parent folder for the Agie job` | `Choose a parent folder for the native wire EDM job` | `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs` |
| Label `A new job folder will contain the native Agie controller files.` | `A new job folder will contain the native controller files.` | `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tabs.rs` |
| Label `Check the effective work quality on Agie Control before assigning cutting steps.` | `Check the effective work quality on the control before assigning cutting steps.` | `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tabs.rs` |

Refusals, grouped by file. The rule: "Agie requires X" -> "The native wire EDM job requires X"; "Agie jobs ..." -> "Native wire EDM jobs ..."; "Agie cannot verify" -> "The native wire EDM post cannot verify"; in `camcraft-post`, "Agie <noun>" -> "The <noun>" or "The job".

| File | Refusals changed | Examples (old -> new) |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/app/src/operation/agie_profile.rs` | 19 | `The Agie job requires a Wire Contour` -> `The native wire EDM job requires a Wire Contour`; `Agie QN2 controls the dielectric settings; ...` -> `The AGIE_QN2 condition controls the dielectric settings; ...`; `Agie work extends outside the stated wire guide heights` -> `The wire work extends outside the stated wire guide heights` |
| `crates/app/src/posting_agie.rs` | 12 | `The Agie job requires the {MODEL} machine profile` -> `The native wire EDM job requires the {MODEL} machine profile`; `Agie jobs require default post options and One program output` -> `Native wire EDM jobs require default post options and One program output`; `Agie post blocked - {op_name}: {text}` -> `Native wire EDM post blocked - {op_name}: {text}`; `Agie operation is unavailable` -> `The Wire Contour operation is unavailable` |
| `crates/app/src/posting.rs` | 1 | `Agie native jobs require a job directory on the desktop or CLI` -> `Native wire EDM jobs require a job directory on the desktop or CLI` |
| `crates/app/src/posting_per_op.rs` | 1 | `Choose One program to create a native Agie job directory` -> `Choose One program to create a native wire EDM job directory` |
| `crates/app/src/posting_mounts.rs` | 1 | `An Agie job requires a single mount and setup` -> `A native wire EDM job requires a single mount and setup` |
| `crates/post/src/agie/contour.rs` | 15 | `Agie coordinates must be finite and within ±9999.9999 mm` -> `Job coordinates must be finite and within ±9999.9999 mm`; `Agie nominal contour crosses or touches itself` -> `The nominal contour crosses or touches itself`; `The Agie rough pass and wire need at least 0.4 mm ...` -> `The rough pass and wire need at least 0.4 mm ...` |
| `crates/post/src/agie/mod.rs` | 9 | `Set the Agie separation cut length (separationLengthMm) ...` -> `Set the separation cut length (separationLengthMm) ...`; `Agie destination {} already exists; choose a new directory` -> `Job destination {} already exists; choose a new directory`; `Agie bundle output requires a local filesystem` -> `Job bundle output requires a local filesystem` |

Total: 58 refusal lines, 6 UI strings, 3 `.cps` strings, 1 post name.

## What did not change

- Identifiers, module names, file names and test names: `posting_agie.rs`, `agie_profile.rs`, `crates/post/src/agie/`, `agie-native.cps`, the `agie-native` golden folders, `examples/agie/`, `mod agie_post`. Open PRs use these names.
- `AGIECUT CLASSIC 2S` (the model in the `.mch` and in the machine-profile refusal): it is the value that the mounted machine file must state. The refusal must name it to say what to mount.
- `AGIE_QN2`: a condition ID that the operator enters on the machine.
- `AGIE.USING_` records: posted controller-file text.
- The user guide title and "Agie Control" in the user guide: they describe the machine and its control, not a feature of CamCraft.
- The script receipt value `"format": "Agie native wire EDM"` (`crates/app/src/script/report.rs`): a script can read it. A change is a breaking change (coordinator decision 4).
- `extension = "agie"` in `agie-native.cps`: an identifier of the output, not traced to a user-visible text.
- The attribution in `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` and `site/static/icons/LICENSES.txt`.
- Posted output: no `.nc` golden and no controller-file golden (`CCSEP20.SBR`, `CCSEP20.SBL`, `CCSEP20.ISO`) changed. No snapshot PNG changed.

## The hidden alias

`posting::agie::LEGACY_POST` holds the old name. `current_name`, `current_ref` and `current_key` (in `crates/app/src/posting_agie.rs`) change it to the new name. They run where a name comes in:

- the project file: the document post (`project/apply.rs`) and a setup's own post (`project/mount_dto.rs`);
- the option keys `builtin:<name>`: `PostScriptOptions::normalize` (`schema.rs`) moves the old key to the new key; an entry under the new key wins;
- the commands `SelectPost::new` (`commands/post.rs`) and `SetSetupPost::new` (`commands/setup_mount.rs`): GUI, MCP and script;
- `posting::resolve_cps`: the script `cam.post({cps})`, the MCP `post` tool and the CLI;
- a machine file's stated post: the `controller.post` check (`machine/validate.rs`) and the post offer (`posting_offer.rs`);
- `agie::is_native` also accepts the old name.

No list shows the old name: `BUILTINS`, `WIRE_POSTS`, the post picker and the MCP name list hold only the new name. The world stores only the new name, so a save writes the new name. The project file version does not change.

Tests (`crates/app/tests/wire_post_alias.rs`):
- `the_new_name_is_listed_and_the_old_name_is_not`
- `the_old_name_selects_the_new_post_by_command_script_and_lookup` (with undo)
- `a_project_saved_with_the_old_name_opens_posts_and_saves_the_new_name`
- `an_option_map_under_the_old_key_normalizes_to_the_new_key`

## Goldens

- 11 files in `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/agie-native/`: `arcs`, `css_then_live`, `drill_retract`, `empty_section`, `extreme_coords`, `full_circle`, `full_circle_raw`, `live_then_stop`, `probe`, `rotary`, `tool_change` (`.refusal`).
- Only line 2 changed. It holds the text of the `.cps` throw at line 16, which changed with the post name. The position `user.cps:16:9` is the same.
- I changed them by a text replace of the old throw text with the new throw text, not by a regeneration.
- The golden test `script_agie_native` confirms them: `11 passed`.

## Tests and gates on head `14e01be84`

All commands run in the worktree with `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=4`.

- `cargo xtask gate test the_new_name_is_listed_and_the_old_name_is_not --crate camcraft-app --binary wire_post_alias --exact`: `passed (4 of 4 tests in `wire_post_alias` passed)`
- `cargo xtask gate test the_old_name_selects_the_new_post_by_command_script_and_lookup --crate camcraft-app --binary wire_post_alias --exact`: `passed (4 of 4 tests in `wire_post_alias` passed)`
- `cargo xtask gate test a_project_saved_with_the_old_name_opens_posts_and_saves_the_new_name --crate camcraft-app --binary wire_post_alias --exact`: `passed (4 of 4 tests in `wire_post_alias` passed)`
- `cargo xtask gate test an_option_map_under_the_old_key_normalizes_to_the_new_key --crate camcraft-app --binary wire_post_alias --exact`: `passed (4 of 4 tests in `wire_post_alias` passed)`
- `cargo xtask gate test list_operation_types_and_skill_match_wire_contour_dto_and_tool_law --crate camcraft-app --binary mcp_wire_contour --exact`: `passed`
- `cargo xtask gate test the_committed_reference_matches_the_live_tool_table --crate camcraft-app --binary mcp_doc_drift --exact`: `passed`
- `cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test agie_native`: `11 passed (the 11 `.refusal` goldens)`
- `cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test conformance`: `7 passed`
- `cargo xtask gate test the_mills_posts_decline_a_plasma_stream_and_the_1300pl --crate camcraft-app --binary plasma_post_refusals --exact`: `passed`
- `cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-post --test script_agie_native`: `11 passed`
- `cargo xtask gate test header_notes_use_each_shipped_dialect_and_keep_the_full_surface_bound --crate camcraft-post --binary comment_escape --exact`: `passed`
- UI (CWD `crates/ui`): `cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-ui --lib -- native_post_dialog`: `3 passed` (3 tests: `native_post_dialog_writes_three_files_and_reports_the_required_work_checks`, `native_post_dialog_refuses_an_invalid_job_name_without_writing_files`, `native_post_dialog_refuses_per_operation_output_without_writing_files`)
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: `702 of 702 steps green, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 75.3 minutes wall; 6402 tests passed, 0 failed, 45 ignored`
- `cargo test -j 4 -p camcraft-app --test 'example_catalog*'` (each `example_catalog*` binary by name): `quick steps 253 to 255: `example_catalog` 37 passed and 4 ignored, `example_catalog_adaptive` 1 passed, `example_catalog_edge_work` 1 passed`
- `cargo xtask gate light`: `Result on head 14e01be84: 3 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The steps are light build (release --no-run), motion light: lib and motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel. All 3 steps are ok.`
- No heavy lane (P3).

## Not exercised

- No run on a physical wire EDM control. The posted files do not change, so the control sees the same job.
- A user machine file that states the old post name: the code path is covered by the alias in `validate.rs` and `posting_offer.rs`, but no test loads such a file.
- A setup's own post with the old name from a project file (`mount_dto.rs`): same alias function as the document post, no own test.
- The unit tests inside `crates/post/src/agie/` (if any assert a refusal text) are run only by the quick gate.
- Clippy did not run as a separate step.

## Screenshots

The pictures are headless renders of the UI test harness at the merge base `4c0a157e1` and at head `14e01be84`. Left: before. Right: after.

Post dialog with the native wire EDM post. The post name, the two labels and the option group change.

![Post dialog before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/1a370768f6ffc76cd53068edf2ae564424da0371/3598/3598-post-dialog-before.png) ![Post dialog after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/1a370768f6ffc76cd53068edf2ae564424da0371/3598/3598-post-dialog-after.png)

![Invalid job name before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/1a370768f6ffc76cd53068edf2ae564424da0371/3598/3598-invalid-name-before.png) ![Invalid job name after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/1a370768f6ffc76cd53068edf2ae564424da0371/3598/3598-invalid-name-after.png)

![Per-operation output before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/1a370768f6ffc76cd53068edf2ae564424da0371/3598/3598-per-operation-before.png) ![Per-operation output after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/1a370768f6ffc76cd53068edf2ae564424da0371/3598/3598-per-operation-after.png)

Status line after a native job post.

![Status line before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/1a370768f6ffc76cd53068edf2ae564424da0371/3598/3598-status-line-before.png) ![Status line after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qsmits/Camcraft/1a370768f6ffc76cd53068edf2ae564424da0371/3598/3598-status-line-after.png)

## Decisions

See [docs/decisions/3537-wire-post-name.md](docs/decisions/3537-wire-post-name.md): a save writes the new name; the machine-profile refusal keeps the model; `AGIE_QN2` and the user guide's "Agie Control" stay; the receipt value stays; no project file version change.

Process change: yes

Changelog: The native wire EDM post is now named "Native wire EDM job files", and its refusals no longer name the machine brand. Projects, scripts and MCP calls that use the old name "Agie native wire EDM" still select the post.

Effort: medium

Fixes #3537
